infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Catch Transit needs your location to detect when you arrive at Mumbai stations and trigger in-game challenges.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Catch Transit tracks your location during a game session — even in the background — so it can detect station arrivals while your phone is in your pocket on the train.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Catch Transit uses your location to detect train station arrivals during a game session.
